column1: #   id  version  file  url  sha256  platforms
# id        the tool's install name; install-tools.sh has one recipe per id.
# file      name the artifact is stored under in the download cache.
# platforms all | linux-x64 | osx-arm64 (artifact is only for that platform).
# Artifacts are official release binaries where a project publishes them (7zz,
# cmake) and release source tarballs otherwise; source is built unattended by
# RARLAB shareware binaries (rar, unrar) are used as black-box oracles only; the
# release archive holds binaries and text, and the unrar source archive is never
# fetched. zip, unzip, cpio and ar come from the
# operating system and are recorded, not pinned (see install-tools.sh).
